argv:
import re, sys
S = r'(?:\s| |<[^>]+>)+'
old = re.compile(S.join(['household' + "'" + 's', 'only', 'admin']) + '|' + S.join(['no', 'role', 'makes', 'a', 'second', 'admin']) + '|' + S.join([r'\bonly', 'one', r'admin\b']) + '|' + S.join([r'\bthe', 'only', r'admin\b']) + '|' + S.join([r'\bone', 'admin,', 'the', 'owner']), re.I)
files = ['ARCHITECTURE.md', 'PLAN.md', 'TECH_STACK.md', 'README.md', 'docs/design/agent-journey.html']
text = {f: open(f, encoding='utf-8').read() for f in files}
stale = [f for f, s in text.items() if old.search(s)]
flat = {f: ' '.join(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>| ', ' ', s).split()) for f, s in text.items()}
need = {'ARCHITECTURE.md': ['| Admins | Several admins; the owner is always one and alone grants or takes back the role', '| member | View only', 'Only admins write'],
        'PLAN.md': ['Several admins, everyone else views (MA-308)', 'Only admins write'],
        'TECH_STACK.md': ['Only admins write'],
        'README.md': ['only admins write', 'views only (MA-308'],
        'docs/design/agent-journey.html': ['Only admins write. There can be several; the owner is always one']}
lack = [f + ': ' + n for f, ns in need.items() for n in ns if n not in flat[f]]
sys.exit(('still one admin: ' + ', '.join(stale) + '; ' if stale else '') + ('lacking: ' + '; '.join(lack) if lack else '') if stale or lack else 0)
